verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents ingesting files, documents, PDFs, images (with OCR), and videos (with transcription), using type-specific extraction. That content can be recalled later through hybrid search over memories and document chunks, or through document search (RAG). Missing for 10: a concrete file-upload API example (endpoint, accepted formats, size limits) and independent hands-on corroboration that recall from uploaded images and PDFs works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store images, PDFs, or other files as memory inputs and recall information from them later

citations.quote: Send any raw content to Supermemory — conversations, documents, files, URLs. We extract the memories automatically.
Multi-modal Extractors | PDFs, images (OCR), videos (transcription), code (AST-aware chunking). Upload and it works.
Detects the content type — PDF, code, markdown, images, video, etc. Extracts content optimally — Uses type-specific extraction (OCR for images, transcription for audio)
It searches both memories and document chunks, returning the most relevant content.
Retrieve three ways — document search (RAG), memory graph traversal, and user profile
